Oven baked bacon rashers in a corn top breakfast roll.

Okay, it’s time to admit it. Our parents were right all along.

Breakfast IS the most important meal of the day. But, with the nation’s favourite bacon roll in a Greggs shop near you, who really has time to make brekkie at home?

No frills. No fuss. Just three rashers of deliciously oven baked bacon, in a pillow-soft, melt-in-your-mouth, white breakfast roll.  All it needs is a little dash of HP or Ketchup (Heinz of course). Breakfast-y bliss.

Oven baked sausages in a corn top breakfast roll.

When something just works, we don’t like messing with it too much.

If you’re looking at this combo of freshly cooked sausages, a pillow- soft, white breakfast roll and your mouth is watering, you’re probably our kind of person.

Freshly prepared every morning, all it needs is a little dash of HP or Ketchup (Heinz of course).

Cheesy omelette in a corn top breakfast roll.

Eggs. They actually are all they’re cracked up to be, you know.

Especially when they’re whipped into a Cheddar cheese omelette, packed into a pillow-soft, white breakfast roll, and lathered with a dollop of Ketchup on top, from our good friends at Heinz.

We’re also proud owners of the Good Egg Award, so you can rest safe knowing our eggy goodness has been well looked after.

The Good Egg Award recognises companies that use cage-free eggs or egg products. To date more than 99 million laying hens are set to benefit each year from award winners’ policies.

The Nation’s favourite Sausage Roll.

Much like Elvis was hailed the King of Rock, many have appointed Greggs as the (unofficial) King of Sausage Rolls.

Freshly baked in our shops throughout the day, this British classic is made from seasoned sausage meat wrapped in layers of crisp, golden puff pastry, as well as a large dollop of TLC. It’s fair to say, we’re proper proud of them.

And that’s it. No clever twist. No secret ingredient. It’s how you like them, so that’s how we make them.

Deliciously light puff pastry with a seasoned Quorn™ filling.

The most hotly debated sausage roll since, well... the Sausage Roll.

Unless you were living under a very large, very heavy rock for most of 2019, you may have noticed we rustled up some serious feathers for Veganuary that year.

Our Vegan Roll Pork-Free is carefully designed to mirror some of the original Sausage Roll’s classic features, including around 96 layers of deliciously light puff pastry. If it aint broke, right?

BUT… instead we wrap it around our own bespoke filling, developed with the help of our friends over at Quorn™. And, in our humble opinion, it continues to be a gamechanger.

(There have been rare cases of allergic reactions to products containing Mycoprotein. Mycoprotein is made with a member of the fungi/mould family. It is high in protein and fibre which may cause intolerance in some people.)

A classic duo of cheese and onion wrapped in a light puff pastry.

Now, we’re not one for bold claims. We’d never, for example, claim that we invented the internet, or that we discovered France. So, we’re certainly not going to stamp our name on ‘cheese and onion’. After all, that tasty flavour combination has been around for ages.

But what we will say is, very few have managed to bundle the classic duo into a savoury quite like our Cheese and Onion Bake. Made with a blend of cheeses and diced onion, they’re freshly baked in our shops every day.

Fresh, simple, and with more cheese than a 90’s rom com. Perhaps it’s time you rediscovered this tasty classic.

Diced beef in a rich and tasty gravy, wrapped in a golden puff pastry parcel.

If you’re after a little taste of lunchtime lovin’ baked in the oven, then you’ve come to the right place.

Packed with diced cuts of beef in a rich and tasty gravy, this golden puff pastry parcel has been a firm favourite for years.

AND, since they’re freshly baked in our shops every day, there’s probably one coming out of the oven RIGHT now.

Unless you’re reading this at 4am. In which case, go to bed. And dream of tomorrow.

Chicken breast pieces in a creamy white sauce with soft cheese, all wrapped up in golden puff pastry.

As a fully fledged Nation of bake lovers, we think it’s only fair we take a moment to shine the spotlight on this timeless classic.

Across Greggs’ many valiant years in the business of baking, we’ve seen our fair share of bakes come and go.

The Chicken Bake undoubtedly has stood the test of time. Always there. In the background. Never hogging the limelight, but always delivering the flavour.

Picture this: chicken breast pieces in a rich and creamy white sauce with soft cheese. These taste sensations are then wrapped in golden puff pastry making them the perfect choice for eating anywhere, at any time.

Sausages, beans and melted cheese wrapped in a golden puff pastry.

Some things were made for each other. Strawberries and cream… Ant and Dec… burgers and gherkins …well, maybe not everything.

But there’s one thing that nobody can deny, and it’s that sausages, beans and cheese are a match made in pastry heaven.

Bursting with delectable baked beans, our sausage meatballs, and gloriously gooey melted cheese, we can just about guarantee that our Sausage Bean and Cheese Melt will tickle your tastebuds.

The Festive Bake is back and better than ever and we’re brave enough to say it: turkey can get stuffed.

We’ve been proudly filling our Festive Bakes with superiorly soft, more moist chicken since 2009 and, this year, we’re not backing down.

Let’s be honest, the countdown to Christmas doesn’t really begin until you’ve had that first bite of a Festive Bake.

Like the obligatory pair of socks in your stocking every year or the office party that always gets out of hand, it just wouldn’t be Christmas without it.

Cooked chicken, smoked ham hock and sweetcure bacon with soft cheese and pork, sage and onion stuffing in a creamy sage and cranberry sauce wrapped in glazed puff pastry with a crumb topping.

The Greggs Festive Bake - hands down the most Christmassy thing about Christmas.

item_name: Roast Chicken and Bacon Club Baguette
item_description:
A crunchy baguette packed with sliced roast chicken breast in mayonnaise, topped with crispy sweetcure bacon, juicy sliced tomato and fresh salad leaves.

Take a bite and enjoy layers of fresh ingredients, crammed full of flavour.

Treat yourself to a baguette that’s big on flavour with our Tandoori Chicken Baguette. Roast chicken breast mixed with a tasty tandoori style mayonnaise, on a bed of fresh salad leaves.

With rich and aromatic spices, it’s a true taste sensation. Like all our sandwiches, our Chicken Tandoori Baguette is freshly made in our shops every day.

Made with tuna in red pepper relish and mayonnaise, with tangy red onion and salad leaves; this baguette truly does blow all the other sandwiches out the water.

Super filling, and massive on flavour, it’s crunchy on the outside and wonderfully soft in the middle. Oh, and like all of our sandwiches, it’s freshly prepared in our shops every day.

Ovals are a great thing. Spoons, diamonds, cricket grounds – terrifying to think where we’d be without them, really. But, our Mexican Chicken Oval Bite may just be the greatest oval of all time.

Packed with slices of Mexican style chicken breast, chipotle chilli sauce, spicy mayo and mixed leaves in a seeded roll – it really is the G.O.A.T.

item_name: Mature Cheddar Cheese Ploughmans Oval Bite
item_description: A mature Cheddar cheese sandwich made with pickle, fresh salad leaves, sliced tomato, cucumber, and red onion, packed into a tasty seeded oval bite. If you’re looking to pair your crisps with something delicious, then look no further.

item_name: Roast Chicken & Honey Mustard Mayo Oval Bite
item_description: Succulent slices of sliced roast chicken breast topped with tomato, cucumber, mixed leaf salad and honey mustard mayonnaise in a seeded oval bite.

There’s plenty of fish in the sea but sometimes all you fancy is a staple sandwich that’ll hit the spot and have you bragging to anyone that’ll listen.

Stop reeling over what’s for lunch and reach for a Tuna Crunch Roll – a soft white and wholemeal roll packed with tuna in red pepper relish and mayonnaise, with tangy red onion and fresh salad leaves.

Catch yourself a lunchtime legend for the perfect bite every time.

item_name: Honey Roast Ham and Egg Salad Roll
item_description:
Made with delicious honey roast ham, layered with sliced free-range egg, tomato, cucumber and fresh salad leaves, packed into a white and wholemeal roll with mayonnaise. This tasty classic is showing no signs of going out of style.

We’re also proud owners of a Good Egg Award, so you can rest safe knowing our eggs are not only cracking, they’ve also been well looked after too.

Creamy, crunchy and a totally perfect pick for lunch.

Roast chicken breast in seasoned mayonnaise, tomato, sliced cucumber and fresh salad leaves packed into a soft white and wholemeal roll. Paired with a bag of crisps and a crisp cold drink, we’d call that a "roll monty".

It’s time to set aside our differences in the great debate of "how to pronounce ‘chipotle’" because we can all agree on one thing: our Mexican Chicken Flatbread packs a punch and delivers on deliciousness.

Our Mexican Chicken Flatbread is made with Mexican style chicken breast, chipotle chilli sauce, fresh salad leaves, mixed peppers and spicy mayonnaise in a soft folded flatbread.

Forget lame lunchbox sandwiches, say hello to our packed-full-of-flavour flatbreads.

A Roast Chicken Salad Sandwich is an absolute classic. Some would say it’s an "OG". Packed with creamy chicken mayo and crunchy salad, it’s time to say hello to a fresh world of deliciousness.

Roast chicken breast in seasoned mayonnaise, tomato, cucumber and mixed leaf salad – wedged between slices of malted brown bread.

Free yourself from the shackles of leftovers for lunch and tuck into an undeniable crowd-pleaser.

Made in tasty malted brown bread with tuna and mayonnaise. We add cucumber for a taste of crunchy freshness, then leave it at that. Nice and simple.

Like all our sandwiches, our Tuna Mayonnaise and Cucumber Sandwich is freshly prepared in shops every day. Pair it with a bag of our salt and vinegar crisps for an elite meal - no matter the time of day.

Soft malted brown bread with sliced egg, mayonnaise, and salad cream

If you’ve forgotten how good an Egg Mayonnaise Sandwich can be, perhaps it’s time to rediscover this tasty classic.

Sticking to the classic recipe, we combine egg mayonnaise with salad cream and slices of free range egg with just a pinch of black pepper. Sandwiched in our own soft malted brown bread, it’s a delicious blast from the past. No fuss. No fancy ingredients.

We’re also proud owners of a Good Egg Award, so you can rest safe knowing our eggy goodness has been well looked after. The Good Egg Award ensures hens lead a cage-free life, allowing them to express their natural behaviours – freedom to move, to scratch and peck, to dust bathe, to stretch and flap their wings, to walk, to run and to rest.

This lunchtime’s finest catch may also be worthy of a frame on the mantlepiece.

One look at our Prawn Layered Pasta Salad and you’ll see exactly why. Cooked pasta in a Marie Rose sauce and vinaigrette dressing mixed with tomatoes and cucumber, layered with cos lettuce, grated carrot, prawns and smoked paprika.

Layers and layers of flavour.

For one of those "I didn’t know what I fancied but this is exactly it" lunches, take a bite of our Tomato & Mozzarella Pasta.

Cooked pasta in a mayonnaise, yoghurt and herb dressing with red pesto, tomato and herb dressing, tomatoes, onions, baby spinach and roasted red peppers, topped with mozzarella pearls and marinated semi dried tomatoes.

A fail-safe combo of ingredients for any occasion.

If a British summer BBQ had a highlights reel, our BBQ Chicken & Bacon Pasta would be the leading role.

Cooked pasta in a yoghurt and herb dressing and mayonnaise with sweetcorn and  tomatoes, topped with smoked bacon and chicken breast in a BBQ sauce.

All the best bits of a BBQ at your fingertips.

There’s no denying we’re a nation of custard lovers.

This gloriously versatile, school dinner favourite can be added to pretty much any dessert to take it from 0-100, and our Caramel Custard Doughnut is no exception.

Take a bite of this doughnut with a custard-style filling, topped with caramel flavour icing and decorated with milk chocolate flavour coating.

A true taste sensation for anyone with a sweet tooth.

A delicious ring doughnut covered in a sugar glaze. Our classic Glazed Ring Doughnut is vegan friendly, so it can be enjoyed by even more of you lovely lot. What a time to be alive.

And, lucky for you, there’s probably one being carefully placed on a Greggs shelf near you, right now. Go, go, go!

Sugar coated doughnut filled with delicious apple and raspberry jam filling.

Caramel Custard Doughnut a little too razzle dazzle for your taste?

Then behold, the Jam Doughnut. An A-lister doughnut with mysterious origins (German really?) fans from all walks of life, and an invite to pretty much any decent Afternoon Tea.

But, at its heart, our take on the Daddy of all doughnuts is a finely balanced mix of delectable apple and raspberry jam filling, a pillowy-soft doughnut and a sugar coating for that subtle crunch.

A timeless classic.

Doughnut filled with apple and raspberry jam, topped with a pink decorative icing.

Jam Doughnuts are pretty great and all, but we promise this is a far superior way to enjoy a sweet treat. We’re just pointing out that alone, jam just doesn’t taste quite as amazing (don’t @ us). So, we’ve done something about that.

Our Pink Jammie Doughnut tastes just as UN-believable as our classic Jam Doughnut with our classic apple and raspberry jam, except we’ve topped it with delectable pink decorative icing for an even more elite doughnutting experience.

Soft ring doughnut with fondant icing and sugar strands.

Ahhh, now this one always gets us a tiny bit nostalgic. The Greggs Sugar Strand Doughnut has been on Greggs’ shelves since what feels like the beginning of time. It’s seen us through the good, the bad, and the ugly. And, the best part; it still tastes bloomin’ AH-mazing.

AND, it’s a known fact that sharing a lil’ snap of this on the ‘gram is guaranteed to get those likes rolling in. Because, hello... it’s pink. This deliciously soft ring doughnut is decorated with fondant and coloured sugar strands.

Single chocolate? Meh. Double chocolate?

Now we’re talking.

Feast your eyes on our Double Chocolate Doughnut; so decadent and so delicious that it deserved two (yes, two) types of chocolate.

Filled with a chocolate filling, topped with a milk chocolate flavour icing and decorated with white and milk chocolate flavour coating… is anyone else drooling just looking at it?

Dreaming of winning the lottery? Travelling the world, designer clothes… Well, we’re aiming slightly lower with the most delicious and most achievable taste of indulgence yet.

Before you start shopping for yachts, let’s start with our Millionaire’s Doughnut and see how a life of luxury suits you:

A ball doughnut with a caramel filling, salted caramel flavour icing, milk chocolate coated shortcake biscuit pieces and white chocolate flavour coating.

It’s exactly like scoring a life-changing sum of money except yummier and more realistic.

Get your pinky raised for this perfectly glazed piece of art. The Vanilla Custard Cream Doughnut not only tastes scrumptious – but it looks the part too.

A ring doughnut with a custard-style filling with vanilla flavour, topped with white chocolate flavour icing and decorated with white and milk chocolate flavour coating.

This slice of the high life is sure to leave you entirely charmed, especially when paired with a freshly brewed cuppa.

Made from crumbly shortcrust pastry, filled with a sweet mincemeat made from vine fruits, Bramley apple, candied orange & lemon peel, perfectly finished with a light dusting of icing sugar.

Our Vegan Friendly Sweet Mince Pies are a thing of beauty!

A soft fruit bun, tangy apricot jam topped with fondant icing.

If you haven’t tried one of these then

1) WHERE have you been?

and

2) Can we ever be friends?

We’ve made your sweet dreams come true with a soft fruit bun, lemon flavoured pieces, wonderfully soaked sultanas, tangy apricot jam, topped with fondant icing… AND a cherry on top. Splendid.

A pillowy-soft choux pasty filled with delicious cream and topped with dark chocolate flavour icing.

Ahhh the good old classic Cream Éclair. This all-time favourite never disappoints.

The classic Sweet Mince Pie taught us a lot about baking an exceptionally delicious festive sweet treat. So much so that we’ve whipped up something new for Christmas this year – introducing: the Sweet Mince Pie Roll.

Puff pastry filled with a sweet mincemeat, made from vine fruits, Bramley apples and candied orange and lemon peel, lightly dusted with icing sugar.

Plus, they’re freshly baked in shops every day and chances are there’s a few coming out of the oven as we speak. So, make like Rudolph and run to get your hands on one.

A human shaped crunchy gingerbread biscuit decorated with chocolate sweets.

Just like chocolate tastes better when it’s egg-shaped (fact), gingerbread tastes infinitely better when it’s shaped like a miniature human. Don’t ask us why. We don’t make the rules.

Our Pumpkin Biscuit is bringing the Halloween spirit to Greggs and we’re not sad about it.

After all, how could you be when you see that smile?

One bite of this ginger biscuit coated in Fairtrade milk chocolate and you’ll get why it might just be the tastiest spooky sweet treat to haunt our shelves.

It might almost be too adorable to eat. Almost!

Shortbread biscuit and a raspberry jam filling.

Our Jammy Heart Biscuits are a combination of delicious crumbly shortbread biscuit and a raspberry jam filling, fit for royalty.

5p from every biscuit goes to the Greggs Foundation, a grant-making trust, aiming to make a difference to people in need in the heart of our communities.

Learn more about all the good stuff they do here:

www.greggsfoundation.org.uk

Cookie made with milk chocolate chunks.

The validity of how good a cuppa is, is determined by which biscuit you’re dipping in it. FACT. So, make sure you do it right. But hell, our cookies are so good, we recommend ordering (and not sharing) every single last one.

Our milk chocolate cookies are soft, crumbly and are made with milk chocolate chunks, something for all chocolate lovers. Or, just ‘people’ as we like to call them. ‘Cause you know, who doesn’t like chocolate?

A delicious chocolate cookie packed with mouth-watering chunks of white and dark chocolate.

If you love chocolate, our Triple Chocolate cookies are about as chocolate-y as it gets. Honestly. Try one. You can thank us later.

We haven’t quite cracked why humans get so excited by things topped with glitter and gold, but we’re more than happy to oblige.

Cast your eyes on our White Chocolate Gingerbread Cookie – a gingerbread flavour cookie with white chocolate buttons, chocolate lentils, crystallised ginger and caramel balls topped with white chocolate flavour coating and gold sugar crunch.

It tastes as luxurious as it looks.

Nothing says Christmas quite like a fancy biscuit. And we must admit, shortbread is about as fancy as they come.

That’s exactly why we’ve brought back our Christmas Mini Caramel Shortbread, just in time for the festive season.

Made with deliciously crumbly shortbread biscuit, topped with caramel and white chocolate and perfectly decorated to make your afternoon tea break that bit more sparkly.

Chocolate muffin with a rich centre of smooth chocolate flavoured sauce.

If you’re not fond of cake, chocolate and good times please look away now.

Being the purveyors of the finest baked goods, we’re pretty much hard-wired to LOVE getting our feed on with delicious, flavour-dense snacks.

The Triple Chocolate Muffin certainly fits the bill: with chunks of moreish chocolate, this decadent chocolate muffin has a rich centre of smooth chocolate flavoured sauce.

Go chocolate or go home, we say.

It’s officially spooky season and our classic Novelty Buns are excited to show you their costumes.

Don’t be fooled - our Spooky Buns are sweeter than they look. Underneath that scary exterior is a vanilla flavour fairy bun, dipped in fondant icing and topped with coloured sprinkles and a sugar paste decoration.

No tricks, just treats.

Preparing for a horror film fest?

What better way to watch than with four of our frightening Spooky Buns?

Deliciously spongey vanilla flavour fairy buns dipped in fondant icing, topped with coloured sprinkles, and finished with Halloween-themed sugar paste decorations.

Our hearts are racing just thinking about it.

Chocolate brownie with dark chocolate, milk chocolate and white chocolate.

Go on – get yourself a little treat.

When it comes to Christmas, there’s some traditions that are better than others. But we have to admit, a fruity Christmas Cake is definitely one of the good’uns.

The Greggs Christmas Cake Slice is made from delicious fruit and ground almonds, topped with a layer of apricot jam, almond marzipan and white icing.

It even comes as a handy slice to enjoy on the go, at your desk, or tucked up in bed with a Christmas classic!

Delicious shortbread with caramel, topped with milk chocolate.

The perfect sweet and crumbly treat to go with your afternoon cuppa!

Our four pack of delightfully crumbly Shortbreads are topped with melt in the mouth caramel with a milk chocolate coating.
